title: Parts Salespersons
description: Sell spare and replacement parts and equipment in repair shop or parts store.

tasks.text: Receive payment or obtain credit authorization.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Transaction processing software-driven; human handles exceptions

tasks.text: Assist customers, such as responding to customer complaints and updating them about back-ordered parts.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Technical explanation to customers needs live interaction

dwas.name: Explain technical product or service information to customers.
dwas.gwa_name: Interpreting the Meaning of Information for Others

tasks.text: Fill customer orders from stock, and place orders when requested items are out of stock.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Ordering via systems automatable; human approves spend

tasks.text: Receive and fill telephone orders for parts.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Order capture automatable; customer interaction partly human

tasks.text: Locate and label parts, and maintain inventory of stock.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — System inventory monitoring automatable; physical audit human

dwas.name: Monitor inventories of products or materials.

tasks.text: Prepare sales slips or sales contracts.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Draft contracts; legal terms human-owned

tasks.text: Read catalogs, microfiche viewers, or computer displays to determine replacement part stock numbers and prices.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Customer needs discovery needs live interaction

dwas.name: Gather customer or product information to determine customer needs.

tasks.text: Determine replacement parts required, according to inspections of old parts, customer requests, or customers' descriptions of malfunctions.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Customer needs discovery needs live interaction

dwas.name: Gather customer or product information to determine customer needs.

tasks.text: Examine returned parts for defects, and exchange defective parts or refund money.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Transaction processing software-driven; human handles exceptions

dwas.name: Examine condition of property or products.

tasks.text: Manage shipments by researching shipping methods or costs and tracking packages.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Shipping cost calculation from rates and weights

dwas.name: Analyze shipping information to make routing decisions.

tasks.text: Mark and store parts in stockrooms, according to prearranged systems.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically moving and shelving stock items

tasks.text: Maintain and clean work and inventory areas.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on cleaning of work areas
physical manipulation — Setting up displays requires hands-on placement

tasks.text: Advise customers on substitution or modification of parts when identical replacements are not available.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Product-use advice is largely informational with review

dwas.name: Advise customers on the use of products or services.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

tasks.text: Discuss use and features of various parts, based on knowledge of machines or equipment.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Product-use advice is largely informational with review

dwas.name: Advise customers on the use of products or services.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

tasks.text: Demonstrate equipment to customers, and explain functioning of equipment.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Technical explanation to customers needs live interaction

dwas.name: Explain technical product or service information to customers.
dwas.gwa_name: Interpreting the Meaning of Information for Others

tasks.text: Measure parts, using precision measuring instruments, to determine whether similar parts may be machined to required sizes.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on dimensional measurement of material

dwas.name: Measure product or material dimensions.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.rationale: decision support — AI can arrange deliveries; exceptions need human handling

dwas.name: Arrange delivery of goods or services.

tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical disassembly and reassembly of parts
